rules.case: A case is one execution of a `with pytest.raises(...)` block of the subject's own tests/ whose statements call decode or decode_complete (of PyJWS or PyJWT, as a method, a module function or the jwt package function) and whose expected exception is a PyJWTError subclass.
rules.target: The target is the single check left after intersecting three candidate sets: the checks that raise the asserted class or a subclass; the checks whose message or attributes satisfy the test's assertions on the exception (match=, assertions after the block), if it makes any; and the checks whose message or condition the test's name names, if it names any. If more than one check is left, the block has no target.
